items.source: If no RouterFunction is provided at construction time, this mapping will detect all router functions in the application context, and consult them in order.
items.translation: 如果未在构造时提供 RouterFunction，此映射将检测应用程序上下文中的所有路由函数，并按顺序进行查询。

items.source: Note: When router functions are detected from the ApplicationContext, this method may return null if invoked prior to afterPropertiesSet().
items.translation: 注意： 当从 ApplicationContext 检测到路由函数时，如果在调用afterPropertiesSet()之前执行此方法，它可能会返回null。

items.source: If this constructor is used, this mapping will detect all RouterFunction instances available in the application context.
items.translation: 如果使用了此构造函数，该映射将检测应用程序上下文中所有可用的 RouterFunction 实例。

items.source: By default this is set to the ServerCodecConfigurer's defaults.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为ServerCodecConfigurer的默认值。

items.source: If this constructor is used, no application context detection will occur.
items.translation: 如果使用了该构造函数，则不会进行应用程序上下文检测。

items.source:
On CORS pre-flight requests this method should return a match not for
the pre-flight request but for the expected actual request based on the URL
path, the HTTP methods from the "Access-Control-Request-Method" header, and
the headers from the "Access-Control-Request-Headers" header.
items.translation: 在 CORS 预检请求中，此方法不应针对预检请求返回匹配结果，而应基于 URL 路径、来自"Access-Control-Request-Method"标头的 HTTP 方法以及来自"Access-Control-Request-Headers"标头的标头，针对预期的实际请求返回匹配结果。
